definitions.gloss: box of sweets given as a gift
definitions.explanation: A boxed assortment of sweets brought as a formal gift: when visiting someone, apologizing, thanking someone, or greeting new neighbors.

examples.japanese: {菓子折|かしお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: To bring a box of sweets.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{詫|わ}び→お詫び：08266_owabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{菓子折|かしお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{謝|あやま}り→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to apologize, taking a box of sweets.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{菓子折|かしお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: To introduce ourselves after moving, we went round the neighbors' houses with boxes of sweets.

notes:
⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ (sweets) + ⟦{折|おり}→折：10250_ori⟧ (a box, originally of folded thin wood). The standard gift for apologies and formal visits, so {菓子折|かしお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{謝|あやま}り→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ is almost a set phrase.
